Selection rationale 
Article: ? (separate article-choice rationale unrecorded). Model: recorded rationale is 
geographic transfer requiring overlap validation. The source supports preferring 
1998 over 1985 because contemporary landing/biomass estimates were available; 
the earlier model has greater catch-reconstruction uncertainty. 
Model extraction 
Accepted canonical parameters retained. Native database JSON differs only in 44 
added taxonomy descriptions. Table 9 (p.143/PDF 147) has 13 B/EE values outside 
strict printed-rounding bounds; PB/QB agree at displayed precision. Oiseaux TL 3.77 
differs from accepted calculated 3.545. Coarse diets and reconstructed 
catch/discards remain limitations. Inherited diet normalization changes cells by at 
most 3.07×10⁻⁸; default GS, derived BA and import 45 remain accepted conventions.

Geographic fit

Temporal fit 
Static 1998 coefficients and historical mixture weights are applied across 1950–2019. 
The reference year is 21 years later; annual ecosystem/fleet changes are not 
reconstructed. 
Other

unavailable source decompositions remain. Full catch mapping does not establish
